industry_capex_rev_basis: trung vi 12 ma xay dung BQ (CC1,CTD,FCN,HUT,L10,L14,L18,LCG,LM8,PC1,TV2,VCG) median quy capex/DT TTM tu 2023Q4
deposit_source: deposit_rate_vn effective 7,4% (CCTG 12M 02/11) - theo sector read Bobby 18/11 + macro snapshot; = diem neo 03/11 => r giu 13,5%
g_basis: ROE base 7% < r => tai dau tu vao mang cu pha gia tri; tang truong qua du an/hop dong moi NPV=0

scenario_basis.bad: ~ 2018-2024: LNST me cong don 7 nam -71 ty (BQ) tren VCSH ~1.100 => ROE ~0; 2% vi da trich lap nhieu (du phong phai thu 871, cho vay 395 da 100%)
scenario_basis.base: (uoc luong) DT 4.500 (TB 2023-25 = 5.538; KH 2026 cong ty me 3.378; them QT II/O Mon 1) x bien gop 7% (BQ GPM TTM 2017-24 1,5-12%, phan lon 3-6%) - QLDN ~100 - bao hanh/du phong ~1% DT + lai rong ~15 + LDLK ~10 => LNTT ~195, LNST ~156 => ROE ~7,2% tren VCSH me 2.168
scenario_basis.good: (uoc luong) DT 6.000 (2024 = 6.102) x bien gop 10% => LNTT ~455; KH 2026 LNTT 450 (DHDCD) => ROE 12-17%; chon 12%

hna_basis: TM4c: HNA gia goc 85,70; dau gia 8,72 trieu cp (vietstock 09/06/2025, ket qua khong tim thay; gia goc khong doi 01/01->30/09 => gia dinh con nam giu, CAN KIEM CHUNG); gia HNA BQ 18/11 20.900 => 182,2; lai an 96,5 x (1-20%) = 77,2
liquidity_basis: (uoc luong) ADV trung vi 90 phien 15.200 cp = 0,45 ty/phien (BQ); Bo Xay dung ~97,9% (78.032.404 cp, vietstock ho so 2020) => free float ~2%; khong co co so do luong doc lap (Amihud/so lieu thuc thi) => 10% la diem giua do nhay 0-20%

sotp.method: Gia tri = gia tri hoat dong (NOPAT/r, g=0) + vi the tai chinh rong SAU no van hanh (theo so sach, NPV=0) + dau tu tai chinh dai han theo so sach + lai an HNA

nopat_basis.base: 0,8 x (4.500 x 4,5% - QLDN 100 - bao hanh/du phong 45) (uoc luong)

sotp.bad_impairment_basis: (uoc luong) rui ro thu hoi phai thu cu chua du phong: PV Power Vung Ang-Quang Trach 876,7 (doi ung chi phi phai tra Vung Ang 1 752,1) + Ban QLDA dien PV Power 312,0 [TM5, TM21]

scenario_method.bad: SOTP: NOPAT -30, ton that phai thu cu 200, vi the TC rong x 0,077 (tien mac ket)

margin_basis.base: TRUNG VI lich su GPM TTM 2017Q3-2024Q4 = 4,55% (BQ); KHONG co co so doc lap cho 7% cua v1 (bien QT II/O Mon chua cong bo) => ha theo trung vi [dinh chinh 7]
margin_basis.good: 7,0% = GPM nam 2025 (cao nhat 9 nam, da gom mot phan quyet toan) [BQ]

sotp.trapped_cash_basis: Kich ban xau: tien mac ket vinh vien chi co gia tri bang lai tien gui thuc nhan: lai tien gui 9T/26 34,4 tren ~3,6 nghin ty = ~1,3%/nam [HN p41] x (1-20%) / r 13,5% = 0,077. Thay cho RI cua v1 => CA 3 kich ban cung phuong phap SOTP [dinh chinh 8]

weights_basis: 25/50/25 doi xung = mac dinh, KHONG co co so dinh luong doc lap; do nhay luoi trong so in trong calc_output. Bang chung nghieng xau (chua dinh luong vao trong so): DHDCD 2026 chon co tuc CO PHIEU 31,7% du cam ~3,6 nghin ty tien; trich quy DTPT +242 (bn PDF tr.43); quyet toan CPH treo; ngoai tru 3 nam lien
